Name: (CP) Fio's Custom Children - Rompers and Festive Wear
Author: PocoFio
Description:
[b][u][size=4]Features[/size][/u][/b]
[b][size=4]🧒Custom Children[/size][/b]
[size=2]Child's appearances are fully customisable to match farmer, spouse or just create your own mix with other options![/size]
[size=2]24+ skin tone[/size]
[size=2]12+ eye colours[/size]
[size=2]8 hairstyles with 23+ hair colours[/size]

[size=4][b]🐣Seasonal Cute Romper[/b][/size]
[size=2]Customize your toddler's romper to fit the season, spouse or just match your flavour![/size]
[size=2]60 unique romper options for each season separately [/size]

[b][size=4]🎪Festive Outfit[/size][/b]
[size=2]Provide several outfit options for toddlers to wear on each festival.[/size]
[size=2]4 outfit options for each festival[/size] [size=1](Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Luau, Moonlight Jellies, SDV Fair, Ice Festival, Winter Star)[/size]
[size=2]35 custome for Spirit's Eve[/size]

🖼️ [b][size=4]Unique Portrait[/size][/b]
[size=2]Add children portraits which follows your appearance setting.[/size]
[size=2]4 themes with unique 8 portraits for each toddler and 1 for both toddlers.[/size]



[b][u][size=4]Q & A[/size][/u][/b]
[b][size=4]🗓️Future Plans [/size][/b]
[size=2]More rompers and portraits. They are cute, why not? [/size]

[b][size=4]🗑️Incompatibility[/size][/b]
[size=2]Additional children[/size]
[size=2]Multiple spouses[/size]

[b][size=4]📫Any suggestion or idea on appearance and wear in your mind?[/size][/b]
[size=2]Leave a comment and suggestion, I'll try to add it soon if I can achieve. [/size]
[size=2]It takes time to draw and coding. Please be patient, thank you:3[/size]



[u][b][size=4]Permission[/size][/b][/u] 
❌DO NOT [size=2]upload my mod to other website.[/size]
❌DO NOT [size=2]edit, use or claim any image in mod without my permission.[/size]
🚫NO AI using.

OK to do without permission:
✅[size=2]Edit images for colour reshade.[/size]
[size=2]✅Edit spouse assets to match other modded sprite.[/size]
[size=2]✅Add new assets for unique spouse.[/size]

[b]How to add compatibility with modded spouse by yourself?[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Add a new folder under 'assets/Spouse'[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Name it as modded spouse's name, for example: Aspen[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Put your png files in the folder like other spouse folder included.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Change children's skintone, eye color and hair color setting to 'Spouse'[/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b][u]Credits[/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Specially thanks [/color][color=#ff7700]ConcernedApe[/color][color=#D4D4D8] for the amazing work on creating Stardew Valley.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod is fully inspired by echoiii's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/796]Children Mod[/url]. I appreciate the lovely romper in mod.

Portrait "The Spirits" pays tribute to the iconic twins standing in the eerie hallway from the legendary horror movie The Shining.
Costume "King of Pop" brings back Michael Jackson’s unforgettable attire from Smooth Criminal.
Costume "ConcernedApe" is dedicated to Eric Barone, the mastermind behind Stardew Valley![/color]
